thread:
Maria (Partnerships): Orbita signed. Want a compact SI onboarding sprint: deliverables = joint PoC + marketplace listing in 4 weeks. Who takes the checklist?
Aj (GTM): Ill own checklist and announcement plan. Need a co-branded one-pager and a short demo runbook.
Devon (Solutions): Ill write the runbook. Need staging credentials and the demo model/prompt set.
Eli (Training): I can produce a 20-25m on-demand walkthrough + a 15-question self-serve badge. Self-serve preferred.
Maria (Partnerships): Good. Include two labs: (1) hit Redwood hosted demo; (2) simple local docker deploy. Badge auto-issues on pass.
Sam (Eng): Staging endpoint: https://staging-orbita.redwood.ai/models/demo-v3. Opening access ticket for Orbita engineers now.
Zoe (Marketing): Ill draft a co-branded sell sheet template. @Maria please share Orbita logo and a 1-line quote.
Aj (GTM): Orbita also asked for marketplace checklist (AWS/GCP). Eng, confirm packaging + metering hook?
Sam (Eng): Marketplace needs: signed manifest, tarball with model artifacts (model.tar.gz + manifest.yaml), and billing webhook. Test payload: POST https://billing-staging.redwood.ai/events {"partner":"orbita","units":120,"resource":"inference_tokens"}. Send contract contact and I'll scope auth.
Devon (Solutions): Minimal PoC prompt pack: concise summarization, multi-turn follow-ups, embeddings search. Ill place final prompts in partners/orbita/prompt-pack.md.
Eli (Training): Proposed partner workshop (60m): 10m intro, 30m hands-on (staging), 10m debugging, 10m quiz.
Maria (Partnerships): Timeline proposed: Week0 kickoff+SOW; Week1 access+training+assets; Week2 PoC runs; Week3 QA+marketplace prep; Week4 listing+joint announce.
Aj (GTM): Works if Eng delivers staging access by EOW and PR plan by Week3.
Sam (Eng): Prioritizing env creation and marketplace manifest template. ETA Fri EOD. Tagging @deploy-bot to provision.
deploy-bot: env-create initiated: workspace=orbita-staging, requested-by=@Sam, status=pending
Zoe (Marketing): For announcement, recommend a short technical note + partner quote. Ill draft and share Tue.
Devon (Solutions): Also proposing a small eval harness to detect regressions during PoC; Ill check it into partners/orbita/evals/ci.yml.
Eli (Training): Partnerships, please DM 3 SI role bullets (implementation engineer, solution architect, sales engineer) so badge scenarios map correctly.
Maria (Partnerships): Will DM role bullets and Orbita contacts. Scheduling 30m kickoff tomorrow 11am PT and sending calendar invite.
Aj (GTM): Recap owners: Aj = checklist + PR; Devon = runbook + eval; Sam = staging + manifest; Eli = training + badge; Zoe = co-branded assets + announcement. Add blockers here. :thumbsup:
